channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: French expression of the day: Jeter la pierre
item.description: This French expression doesn't have much to do with actually throwing rocks.

item.title: How to make The Local one of your preferred sources on Google
item.description: Do you like and trust The Local? Then please take a moment to add us as a preferred source on Google to ensure our articles appear in your searches.

item.title: What new French citizenship rules mean for children raised in France
item.description: France has brought in some changes to how income rules are applied for citizenship - which have potentially huge consequences for children who moved to France with their parents at a young age and grew up here.

item.title: How much money do I need for French citizenship?
item.description: Becoming French requires you to be 'sufficiently economically integrated' - but what does this mean in cash terms? Will you be penalised for being on minimum wage or accepting social benefits? And how much does it cost to become French?

item.title: British man on €1,600 a month denied French citizenship for 'insufficient income'
item.description: A British man who has lived in France since he was three years old and who hoped to join the French fire service has told how his French citizenship application has been turned down as his €1,600 a month income was deemed not to be 'sufficient and stable'.

item.title: 6 tips for raising bilingual children in France
item.description: Kids who grow up bilingual are spared much of the misery of language classes - but helping children master two languages is often a balancing act. Bilingual journalist Emma Albright spoke to some parents who have successfully raised children with two languages.

item.title: Killing of far-right activist stokes tensions in France
item.description: France's government accused the hard left on Monday of being partly responsible for the killing of a far-right activist last week.

item.title: France grants safe haven to anti-Kremlin couple detained by ICE
item.description: France has granted safe haven to an anti-Kremlin Russian activist couple detained by ICE in the United States, but his wife was nowhere to be found after he landed in Paris on Monday.

item.title: Buying and selling property in France: Who pays for what?
item.description: Who pays the notaire? Covers the cost of surveys? What about the estate agent? And property taxes?

item.title: France loosens rules on allowing farmers to shoot wolves
item.description: The French government said Monday it would authorise the shooting of wolves that attack livestock even outside protected enclosures, a policy shift welcomed by farmers, a powerful and increasingly disgruntled constituency.
